% Pattern: env/newtheorem/article. A counter within section, shared by two
% environments, and an unnumbered environment.
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1 status=here labels=thm:a
% want proof-1 proof - proves=theorem-1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1.2 status=none
% want remark-1 remark -
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 2.1 status=here
% want proof-2 proof - proves=theorem-2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\newtheorem*{remark}{Remark}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem}\label{thm:a}
Every $x$ is $x$.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
Clear.
\end{proof}
\begin{lemma}
A lemma with no proof.
\end{lemma}
\begin{remark}
A remark.
\end{remark}
\section{Two}
\begin{theorem}
Another one.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
Also clear.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
